items.stem: In a vapour-compression refrigeration cycle, the component that absorbs heat from the conditioned space is the:

options.rationale: Correct: the evaporator absorbs heat from the space as the refrigerant vaporises.
The condenser rejects heat; it does not absorb it from the space.
The compressor raises refrigerant pressure; it does not absorb space heat.
The expansion valve drops pressure; it is not the heat-absorbing component.

items.explanation: Correct: the evaporator absorbs heat from the space as the refrigerant vaporises.

items.stem: A cooling load calculation that includes only sensible heat and omits moisture removal will most likely:

options.rationale: Correct: ignoring latent (moisture) load understates the total cooling requirement.
Omitting a real load cannot overestimate the total.

options.text: Have no effect on the total
options.rationale: Latent load is a real component, so omitting it changes the total.
Latent load affects the cooling, not heating, calculation here.
